wikidata_candidates.label: Harry Nilsson
wikidata_candidates.reasoning: This was a surname-only fallback search. Harry Nilsson was an American singer-songwriter from Brooklyn, not a Swedish laser physicist in Uppsala.

wikidata_candidates.label: Sven Nilsson
wikidata_candidates.reasoning: Sven Nilsson was a Lund zoologist who died in 1883, long before the 1967-1972 card. The surname is the only thing he shares with the card.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala University
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is Uppsala University, the research university in Uppsala, Sweden, which the card names as the employer. The card's Institute of Physics is one of its units.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala University Hospital
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is the university's teaching hospital, a separate institution owned by Region Uppsala. It is not the university's physics institute.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala University Faculty of Medicine
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is the Faculty of Medicine, a sub-unit of the university. The card names the physics institute instead.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala University Library
wikidata_org_candidates.description: academic library at Uppsala University in Uppsala, Sweden
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is the university library, a sub-unit of the university and not the employer itself.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala University Coin Cabinet
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is the university's numismatic collection (coin cabinet), not the university.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala University Department of Archaeology
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is the Department of Archaeology, a different sub-unit from the card's Institute of Physics.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala University Choir
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is a student choir, not the university.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala university 500 years
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is a 1977 book about the university, not the institution.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Book of Hours of Johannete Ravenelle
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is a medieval manuscript held by Uppsala University Library. It only matched through its shelfmark alias.

wikidata_org_candidates.label: Uppsala University Library, e-books on demand
wikidata_org_candidates.reasoning: This is an e-book service run by the library, not the university.
